definitions.role: base minus reversed within same case
definitions.unrelated: base case i minus base case (i+1) mod 4; deliberately different lexical content
definitions.step_gram: cosine between every pair of full-dimensional adjacent-layer increments
definitions.mean_within_gram_corr: Pearson correlation of upper-triangle step-Gram entries over the six case pairs
definitions.speed: Euclidean adjacent-layer increment norm; speed correlation is not coordinate-scale invariant
definitions.directness: endpoint distance divided by path length

toy.interpretation: A single unlabeled O(d)-invariant path cannot distinguish operation order here; an independently labeled anchor path can.

limitations: Only four exposed role-reversal examples; no held-out test or task contrast.
Unrelated-sentence control changes more than role and is a genericity check, not a matched syntax control.
Layer index is treated as aligned for diagnostics only; both models happen to have 28 blocks.
No learned alignment, no claim of mechanism or statistical generalization.
